values.note: Operator's reservation page (which carries its 2026 booking rules): camping $45 daily, $270 weekly, $675 monthly; tent $14 per day. Paying online adds a $5/night convenience fee; paying at the campsite does not.

fees.source: https://summersvillelakerentals.com/reservation/ (price table: Camping $45 Daily Rate, $270 Weekly Rate, $675 Monthly Rate; Tent $14 Per Day; 'If you pay online there is a $5 per night convenience fee, but you can pay at the campsite for the regular rate'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://summersvillelakerentals.com/ ('19 full hookup camping spots'; Section 2 sites 'fully equipped with 50/30-amp electrical hook-ups') + https://summersvillelakerentals.com/camping/ ('Deluxe Pull Thru Sites with 50/30 Amp Service and WiFi'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 19 full-hookup sites plus 4 newer back-in 50/30-amp sites in the wooded Section 2; tent sites out on the North Point. One camping unit, one vehicle (two at most) and 6 people per site.

sites.source: https://summersvillelakerentals.com/ ('19 full hookup camping spots available now and we have 4 new campsites in our new section') + https://summersvillelakerentals.com/camping/ + https://summersvillelakerentals.com/campground-rules-and-regulations/, read 2026-10-21

values.note: WiFi at the deluxe pull-through sites and now in Section 2 (the Section 2 announcement also still says internet is 'intentionally unavailable' there). Dumpsters for trash.

facilities.source: https://summersvillelakerentals.com/camping/ ('Deluxe Pull Thru Sites with 50/30 Amp Service and WiFi') + https://summersvillelakerentals.com/ ('WiFi service is now available in the new Section 2 camping area'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Book and pay on the operator's own site, or pay cash/check at the drop box at the Red Pavilion. In 2026, holiday weekends (Memorial Day, Labor Day, July 4th) need 3 nights and a 50% deposit. A reservation may be given away if you have not arrived or called by sundown. Check-in noon, check-out 10 am; register at the office.

booking.source: https://summersvillelakerentals.com/reservation/ ('In 2026: You are allowed to reserve a minimum of 3 days on HOLIDAY WEEKENDS. (Memorial Day, Labor Day, July 4th)') + https://summersvillelakerentals.com/ ('2 Ways to Pay') + https://summersvillelakerentals.com/campground-rules-and-regulations/, read 2026-10-21

note: Private RV park & cabins on a 140-acre mountain-top property 1.5 miles from the Battle Run boat launch at Summersville Lake (Nicholas Co); the four newer Section 2 sites sit in the wooded, shaded part of the property. The lake is a nearby attraction, not at the sites. --Claude
summary: summersvillelakerentals.com is this park's own site (headed 'Mountain top, RV Park, & Cabins', 191 Campground Rd; Google's listing links it). Confirmed 50-amp full hookups. Added $45/night base (2026 page; $270 weekly, $675 monthly), 23 RV sites with pull-throughs, wifi, own-site booking with a 3-night holiday-weekend minimum. Not stated: season, showers/restrooms, max rig length.
flags: Price gate: base $45/night (operator's 2026 reservation page); paying online adds an avoidable $5/night convenience fee (pay at the campsite and it is $45). Under US$50; New River Gorge NP is 22 km away anyway; the family has not stayed here.
